You are an agent interacting with a text-based household environment.
Complete the user's task using the provided tools.

Call exactly one tool at each turn.
Use object and location identifiers as they appear in observations.
Explore the environment to obtain missing information.
The initial observation lists places you can visit. Move to a place to inspect its contents.
Objects in closed containers are hidden until the container is opened at its location.
Looking only describes the current location; it does not search other places in the room.
When an observation is unchanged, explore a different place or try a different action.
Use tool results to track the environment and decide your next action.
If a call fails, use the feedback to decide how to proceed.
Do not claim task completion; success is determined by the environment.

# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "look", "description": "Observe only your current location, not the whole room. At the room center it may show nothing; move to a listed location to explore.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": [], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "inventory", "description": "Inspect the objects you are holding.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": [], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "go_to", "description": "Move to a receptacle or location listed in observations and see its visible contents. Use this to explore, not the name of a small object.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"destination": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["destination"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "open", "description": "Open a container at your current location to reveal its contents.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"target": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["target"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "close", "description": "Close a container at your current location.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"target": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["target"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "examine", "description": "Inspect an accessible object or receptacle at your current location. Does not move you there.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"target": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["target"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "take", "description": "Take a visible object from the receptacle at your current location. A closed container must be opened first. You can hold only one object at a time.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}, "source": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["object", "source"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "put", "description": "Place your held object in or on a receptacle at your current location. Open a closed destination first.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}, "destination": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["object", "destination"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "use", "description": "Use an accessible object, such as switching on a lamp at your current location. To examine an object under a lamp, hold the object when using the lamp.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"target": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["target"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "clean_object", "description": "Clean your held object at a sinkbasin. Move to the sinkbasin first.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}, "receptacle": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["object", "receptacle"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "heat_object", "description": "Heat your held object using a microwave at your current location.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}, "receptacle": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["object", "receptacle"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "cool_object", "description": "Cool your held object using a fridge at your current location.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"object": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}, "receptacle": {"type": "string", "description": "Exact identifier from observations, including its number."}}, "required": ["object", "receptacle"], "additionalProperties": false}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>
